purpose: Non-admission research record for Berlin's historical Umweltatlas building-height 2022 WFS, deliberately kept separate from monthly ALKIS and without geometry or attribute retrieval authorization.

entries.name: Berlin Umweltatlas 2022 LoD2 building roof height WFS
entries.provider: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin
entries.spatial_scope: Berlin, Germany; distinct citywide 2022 Umweltatlas building and building-part height layer, not the current ALKIS building WFS
entries.temporal_scope: Published 2022-04-06, dataset portal updated 2023-08-23; underlying ALKIS footprint source dated 2022-04-07 according to official methodology; not current monthly ALKIS
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Individual 2D polygon building/part representations derived from 3D LoD2 with first-height metres, roof type, storeys, method and footprint-date fields; source height may be missing or imputed
entries.note: Official catalogue lists dl-de-zero-2.0; exact downstream rights and API terms still require review. Source explicitly derives roof heights from Berlin LoD2 and historical ALKIS geometry; it is NOT independent ground truth or the same vintage as current monthly ALKIS WFS, and 3 m may be assigned when a height cannot be determined. Technical fields include hoehe, dachart, geschosse, role_txt, source-method and footprint-vintage indicators, but documented fields are not proof of populated live WFS attributes. Preserve missing-vs-imputed status and source method before any scientific join; no automatic identity-by-name, address or feature ID; no TIV, insured location, vulnerability, loss or model input inferred.
